answer: An agent economy can weight governance votes by tokens locked for 30 days, with no bonus for opening an account. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand agents still buys only 100 tokens of voting power. This rule forms a trellis for cooperation: an oasis of cheap identities cannot divert the river of votes. To gain control, an attacker must acquire and immobilize enough tokens, paying their purchase price and losing liquidity during the lock.
